evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies error handling in src/rpc/mining.cpp to return standard RPC_CLIENT_NOT_CONNECTED on shutdown.
rationale: Ensures standard RPC error codes are returned instead of internal assertion errors during shutdown. Rather than reporting a non-fatal internal bug, getblocktemplate and generateblock throw standard RPC_CLIENT_NOT_CONNECTED ('Shutting down') errors.
